blocks.html: A Revenue Growth Engine is an integrated system of people, processes, data, and technology working together to generate, convert, and expand revenue in a scalable and predictable manner.

The Revenue Growth Engine aligns marketing, sales, and customer success functions into a unified system focused on continuous revenue generation. It ensures that every stage of the customer lifecycle—from lead generation to retention—is optimized for growth and efficiency.
A revenue growth engine typically includes:

items.html: Lead generation and demand creation systems

blocks.html: All components work together to create predictable revenue outcomes.
